passage.quote: `role`: specifies the source of each message. As described in #levels_of_authority and #chain_of_command, roles determine the authority of instructions in the case of conflicts. - `system`: messages added by OpenAI - `developer`: from the application developer (possibly also OpenAI) - `user`: input from end users, or a catch-all for data we want to provide to the model - `assistant`: sampled from the language model - `tool`: generated by some program, such as code execution or an API call
